neighbours.label: Local movement toward or out of a place in everyday narration
fire: On the way out of the library, she noticed a poster.
The children moved to the next table for the puzzle.
I picked up my scarf and went outside to wait.
He carried the kitten to a nearby garden.
They made their way toward the ticket counter.
From the meeting I rushed to the station.
The swimmer crossed the pool to reach the ladder.
She walked down the hallway into the kitchen.
quiet: Inside the library, she noticed a poster.
The children stayed at the same table for the puzzle.
I picked up my scarf and stayed inside to wait.
He held the kitten in a nearby garden.
They waited beside the ticket counter.
After the meeting I remained at the station.
The swimmer rested in the pool beside the ladder.
She stood in the hallway beside the kitchen.
